posts.text:
Monday, Nov 9: Toronto's streetcars lost 918 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 510 Spadina southbound. A typical 4.9 km trip lost 12 min (usually 12).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 12 min over 7.8 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Monday's slowest spot: Northbound on Dundas St West, approaching Bloor St West.
The average streetcar lost 1 min 56 s here (usually 1 min 33 s). Across 322 trips, that adds up to 10.4 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Dundas St West around Bloor St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the northbound stretch at Bloor St West is highlighted, peaking at about 1 min 56 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Dundas St West northbound, approaching Bloor St West
shot.sub: Monday, Nov 9: 1 min 56 s lost per streetcar · 322 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Monday, Nov 9: 510 Spadina. 1 in 15 trips (31) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side (southbound, 23), instead of going on to Union Station.

Across all routes, 2% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 510 Spadina route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side, gives how many southbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Union Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Monday, Nov 9: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

31% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 276 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 31% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Monday, Nov 9: at the busiest moment (6:10 pm), 151 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 100% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,048 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 95% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Monday, Nov 9, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 151 streetcars at 6:10 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 100% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Monday, Nov 9: Spadina Ave at Queens Quay West North Side (510 Spadina northbound).

Riders waited 9.5 min on average, against 4.9 if cars had come as scheduled: 4.6 min extra. 1 in 12 cars came bunched, and 29 of 126 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Spadina Ave at Queens Quay West North Side in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 4.6 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
